name: Flynn Salisbury
original_name: フリン・ソールズベリー
source:
[i]"If we're not welcome here, we shall leave. I expect the lot of us have little time to waste... We have vampires to hunt."[/i]

[b]Occupation:[/b] Vampire hunter
[b]Interest:[/b] Plushies
[b]Weapon:[/b] Sickle

A young vampire hunter with an elite upbringing. His parents are accomplished hunters and, as their son, the expectation to be just as brilliant was placed upon his shoulders from an early age.

In contrast to his cold demeanor in battle, he is generally a polite young man with a fondness for sweet treats.

[From [url=https://products.voltage.co.jp/redbell/english/characters/?page=flynn]Voltage Inc.[/url]]
